quotes.author: Bruce Jones
quotes.text: We booked a trip to catch striper or what some people call rockfish. Within 20 minutes of going out we were catching fish. We caught our limit and continue to catch fish for 4 1/2 hours. Only takes 10 minutes to get to the fishing holes, so you’re spending all your time fishing. Captain Jeff was fantastic. Knew what to do and where to go. He has the right lures and rigs and the proper electronic equipment. What a great day. You have to do this trip?

quotes.author: Tim Bourne
quotes.text: Had a great day fishing on board the Vistalady. Caught lot striper due to Captain Ryan getting us on the fish. Absolutely love the 1st mate. Krammer. He was a very personable and a funny guy. Thanks Krammer taking care of. That was my 10 trip on the Vistalady and looking forward to my 11th trip. Thanks again!!!!

quotes.author: Jim Coll
quotes.text: Decided at the last minute to try and book something for my son and I. Luckily captain Ryan was available. He was great and we had a great time. Catching stripers in shallow water is a blast, and it's great to actually use techniques and really do some fishing. We will be back

quotes.author: Paul Gibson
quotes.text: Great time! Capt. Ryan & his mate were friendly and knowledgeable. We caught our limit on Stripers and were brought to another spot where we caught a mix of lots of fish. Boat was very clean and comfortable. Will definitely do again when in the area!

quotes.author: John Sumner
quotes.text: My son and I did a trip with Cpt. Jeff today. It was fantastic! Jeff is very friendly with a lot of years of fishing and some great stories. We’ll definitely be booking again with him.

quotes.author: Carsen Cachelin
quotes.text: First time going out for rockfish. We had an amazing time and limited out super easily and then continued to catch more. Thank you captain Jeff for an amazing trip.
